policy: A product is checkoutable only when this registry contains ready=true, operator_required=false, and a verified zero-human fulfillment contract. Products without that contract must not be sold.

BILLBOARD-SMALL.activation: verified_paid_stripe_session -> signed_webhook -> exact_amount_currency_validation -> buyer_field_validation -> public_image_fetch_validation -> automatic_moderation -> atomic_first_available_100x100_grid_allocation -> media_persist -> billboard_state_persist -> publication -> durable_fulfillment_proof
BILLBOARD-SMALL.failure_behavior: payment remains recorded but publication is not marked complete until every fulfillment step succeeds; retry is idempotent
